_comment: ASR with static windows (buckets), SenseVoice host features and the Zipformer RNN-T head. ONNX from build_zip150_buckets.py --with-encoder-out and export_sensevoice_buckets.py; decoder/joiner from Hugging Face hynt/ZipFormer-150M-CR-CTC-RNNT-6000h. Copy the MT / TTS entries from models.dev.json. On the box use "ctx" + "graph_index" from tools/build_asr_buckets_aihub.py instead of "onnx". See docs/asr_optimization.md.
